summary_en: Tender offer price for Kakaku.com raised to ¥3,570 per share from ¥3,450. Self-stock acquisition price by Kakaku.com adjusted to ¥2,902 per share from ¥2,805, applicable after share consolidation. Digital Garage to not gain relative benefit versus other shareholders; after-tax proceeds from self-stock acquisition intended to be equivalent to proceeds from tendering at the new offer price.
title_en: Notice Regarding Change in Conditions of Public Tender Offer for Shares of Kakaku.com Inc. (Equity-Method Affiliate)
translation_en_brief: On 13 August 2026, Digital Garage announced that Kamgras 1 K.K., a special-purpose acquisition vehicle controlled by EQT AB (through BPEA Fund IX Pte. Ltd.), has increased the public tender offer price for Kakaku.com Inc. common shares to ¥3,570 per share (from ¥3,450), effective immediately. The self-stock acquisition price—applicable after a planned share consolidation and only if the tender offer does not acquire all outstanding shares—has been raised to ¥2,902 per share (from ¥2,805). The tender offer, which began on 13 May 2026, aims to privatize Kakaku.com. Digital Garage, which holds approximately 20.68% of Kakaku.com as of 31 March 2026, is a party to a non-tendering agreement with the offeror. The company states that the price adjustment ensures its after-tax proceeds from the self-stock acquisition would be substantially equivalent to the proceeds it would receive by tendering at the new offer price, such that it gains no relative benefit versus other shareholders. The adjustment was made to accelerate realization of synergies and preserve Kakaku.com as a core strategic investment during the EQT-led transaction timeline.
